summary: TELUS Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 6, 2026, in which its Board of Directors declared a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.1875 Canadian per common share, payable January 4, 2027 to holders of record at the close of business on December 11, 2026. The notice was signed by Andrea Wood, EVP and Chief Legal and Governance Officer. No stake, price per share, premium, advisor, board recommendation on a transaction, or special-situations mechanics are present. This is an ordinary dividend declaration, not a capital-returns event; nothing for a risk-arb angle.
